Samir K.: Customer report — SSO stopped working right after their IdP cert rotation. They say login redirects to our ACS but we return 400 / AssertionConsumerServiceNotFound.
Jade T.: Ugh. Which customer / IdP? any recent metadata fetches?
Samir K.: tenant: acme-health (prod). I fetched their metadata earlier: `curl -sS https://idp.acme-health.com/metadata > idp.xml`
Samir K.: I compared certificates and the cert fingerprint in the metadata changed (expected). But the SAML response we get contains an Assertion signed with a `<KeyInfo>` that our parser doesn't match to the metadata.
Lina S.: Can you paste the exact error from our logs?
Samir K.: From auth-service logs: `saml:AssertionConsumerServiceNotFound: Requested ACS URL 'https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs' not found for SP 'https://acme-app/'`
Samir K.: But their IdP is redirecting to `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs/` (note trailing slash). The ACS we have registered for the tenant is `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs` (no slash).
Jade T.: Trailing slash mismatch can cause ACS not found. We usually accept both — did we recently tighten validation?
eng-oncall: @Jade we deployed the stricter ACS exact-match validation in rollout v2 (2025-11-03) to mitigate open-redirect risk. Could cause this.
Samir K.: Also noticed the IdP metadata XML uses a default namespace and their `<KeyDescriptor use="signing">` appears before the `<KeyDescriptor use="encryption">`, while previously the signing key was second. Our XML parser is picking the first cert by index in some code path used during rotation matching.
Lina S.: Hmm, two simultaneous issues: ACS URL exact-match + cert ordering/namespace parsing. Either could break. Which one is causing Assertion signature mismatch vs ACS not found?
Samir K.: The error about ACS not found is coming earlier — IdP posts to ACS with trailing slash, we 404 / throw AssertionConsumerServiceNotFound before signature verification.
Jade T.: Workaround: we can add the `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs/` as an allowed ACS in their tenant config temporarily. Can we do that via admin UI?
Samir K.: Yes, tenant admin panel -> SSO config -> ACS URLs add. But customer doesn't have admin access right now (they're waiting on us).
Lina S.: I'll add it for them. @auth-bot can you record the change and pin for rollback after cert rotation?
auth-bot: Recorded change under ticket #CUST-9827. Added ACS `https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs/` for tenant acme-health. :white_check_mark:
Samir K.: After adding the trailing-slash ACS the IdP POSTs were accepted. But we still saw a warning: `saml:SignatureValidationFailed` for some assertions when the IdP used new cert.
Jade T.: That suggests cert matching problem. Can you share the KeyInfo from the SAML response (sanitized) and the idp.xml snippet?
Samir K.: Pasted snippet to secure note: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme-health.com/" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:metadata">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <KeyInfo>...CERT A (new) ...</KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="encryption">
      <KeyInfo>...CERT B (old) ...</KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Samir K.: But the SAML Assertion's Signature KeyInfo contains CERT B (old) — looks like IdP rotated and is signing with the old cert for some legacy issuer cluster while metadata shows new primary.
Lina S.: Could be propagation delay across IdP nodes. Also note XML namespace prefixing: their metadata has `xmlns="...metadata"` and our parser path for `//ds:KeyInfo` relies on the ds namespace being declared with prefix — some of their metadata uses unprefixed ds elements which our XPath misses.
Jade T.: That's nasty. Two issues: inconsistent ACS URL and metadata XML namespace/ordering plus propagation. Steps: 1) keep the trailing-slash ACS added temporarily 2) ask IdP to confirm all nodes serve consistent metadata (and no stale certs) 3) make our parser more robust to ds: vs unprefixed KeyInfo (ticket to eng).
Samir K.: I requested IdP team to flush caches and confirm. They said rotation was staged and some nodes still sign with old cert for up to 48hrs.
eng-oncall: We'll open an internal bug: `SAML-1738` — make ACS matching tolerant to trailing slash when tenant explicitly registers both or we do normalization; and `SAML-1739` for namespace-robust cert matching.
Jade T.: For immediate customer unblock: keep extra ACS, ask IdP to finish roll, and if signature mismatch persists, capture the raw SAML response and we'll add temporary trusted cert fingerprint in tenant config.
Samir K.: I captured raw SAML response and uploaded to secure ticket. Also added temporary fingerprint `SHA1:3A:5B:...` to tenant config as emergency override.
Lina S.: Please ensure we add a TTL to that override and create an automated reminder to remove after 72h.
auth-bot: Emergency cert override applied with TTL 72h. Audit logged.
Samir K.: Customer able to log in now. Will follow up tomorrow to confirm IdP finished propagation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Jade T.: I'll sync with eng on SAML-1738/1739 prioritization. Leaving note to update support KB with steps: check trailing slash, fetch metadata, compare `<KeyDescriptor>` order, and how to apply emergency fingerprint override.
eng-oncall: Noted. Assigning to @Lina to own KB draft.
Lina S.: On it.
Samir K.: Marking thread resolved for now.
